scrap the plan: Because it cost far too much money, the city decided to scrap the plan for a new stadium completely.
因為花費太高，市政府決定完全廢除興建新體育場的計畫。
scrap a car: It is often cheaper to scrap a car that is twenty years old than to keep paying for repairs.
把一輛二十年的老車報廢，往往比一直付修理費便宜。
scrap the project: After the main investor pulled out, the company had no choice but to scrap the project and stop all work.
主要投資者撤資後，公司別無選擇，只能取消專案並停止所有工作。
scrap of paper: She wrote her phone number on a scrap of paper and handed it to me before the bus left.
她在一張紙片上寫下電話號碼，在公車開走前交給我。
scrap metal: The old man earns a little money by collecting scrap metal and selling it to the recycling center.
那位老人靠收集廢金屬賣給回收中心賺一點錢。
scratch the surface: This short video can only scratch the surface of climate change; there is much more to learn about it.
這支短片只能觸及氣候變遷的皮毛；關於它還有更多東西要學。
scratch one's head: The math problem was so difficult that it made even our teacher scratch his head for a few minutes.
那道數學題難到讓連我們老師都搔頭苦思了好幾分鐘。
scratch a living: In the small fishing village, many families could only scratch a living from the sea.
在這個小漁村，許多家庭只能靠大海勉強餬口。
start from scratch: My computer crashed and I lost my report, so I had to start from scratch the night before it was due.
我的電腦當機，報告不見了，所以我必須在截止前一晚從零開始。
scratch my back and I'll scratch yours: The two shop owners agreed on a simple rule: scratch my back and I'll scratch yours, so they recommend each other's stores.
兩位店主同意一個簡單原則：互相幫忙，所以他們會推薦彼此的店。
up to scratch: The teacher said my essay was not up to scratch and asked me to rewrite the ending.
老師說我的作文不合格，要我重寫結尾。
screen candidates: The company uses a short online test to screen candidates before inviting the best ones to an interview.
公司先用一份簡短的線上測驗篩選候選人，再邀請最好的人來面試。
screen for cancer: Doctors suggest that people over fifty should get regular checkups to screen for cancer early.
醫生建議五十歲以上的人應定期健康檢查，及早篩檢癌症。
screen a film: The school will screen a film about wildlife in the hall on Friday, and all students are welcome.
學校星期五將在禮堂放映一部關於野生動物的電影，歡迎所有學生參加。
screen calls: My aunt lets the phone ring to screen calls from unknown numbers and only picks up when she sees a friend's name.
我阿姨讓電話一直響來過濾陌生號碼的來電，只有看到朋友的名字才接。
screen off: The restaurant used tall plants to screen off a quiet corner for customers who wanted privacy.
餐廳用高大的盆栽隔開一個安靜的角落，給想要隱私的客人。
screw up: Don't worry if you screw up the first time; everyone makes mistakes when they are learning to drive.
如果第一次搞砸了也別擔心；每個人學開車時都會犯錯。
screw up one's courage: Finally, he tried to screw up his courage and ask the girl he liked to go to the movies with him.
最後，他試著鼓起勇氣，邀請他喜歡的女生和他一起去看電影。
screw someone over: The dishonest salesman tried to screw us over by charging twice the normal price for a used phone.
那個不誠實的業務員想坑我們，二手手機竟收兩倍的正常價格。
have a screw loose: People thought he had a screw loose when he said he would ride his bike around the island in a week.
當他說要在一週內騎腳踏車環島時，大家都覺得他腦筋不正常。
tighten the screws: When the factory kept polluting the river, the government began to tighten the screws with heavier fines.
當工廠持續污染河川時，政府開始以更重的罰款施壓。
script a show: Our class spent two weeks trying to script a show for the school festival, writing every line together.
我們班花了兩週為校慶節目寫腳本，每句台詞都一起寫。
a scripted answer: The politician gave a scripted answer that sounded as if he had memorized it the night before.
那位政治人物給了一個照稿念的回答，聽起來好像他前一晚背好的。
stick to the script: The director told the actors to stick to the script and not add any jokes of their own.
導演要演員照稿演出，不要自己加任何笑話。
go off script: During the live interview, the singer decided to go off script and talked openly about her family.
在現場訪問中，那位歌手決定脫稿，公開談論她的家人。
scrub the floor: After the party, we had to scrub the floor for an hour to remove all the sticky juice.
派對結束後，我們得花一小時刷地板，把黏黏的果汁都清掉。
scrub a mission: Because of strong winds, the space agency had to scrub a mission just minutes before the rocket launch.
因為強風，太空總署不得不在火箭發射前幾分鐘取消任務。
scrub data: Before analyzing the survey, we need to scrub data to remove errors and repeated answers.
在分析問卷之前，我們需要清理資料，刪除錯誤和重複的答案。
scrub up: Before every operation, the doctors and nurses must scrub up carefully to kill germs on their hands.
每次手術前，醫生和護士都必須仔細刷手消毒，殺死手上的細菌。
scrub out: She tried hard to scrub out the coffee stain on her white shirt, but it would not come off.
她努力想擦掉白襯衫上的咖啡漬，但就是洗不掉。
